title: The Mercy of Gods
author: James S. A. Corey
summary: A group of scientists is taken by a powerful alien empire that has conquered other species. Held far from home, the humans are put to work and have to work out how to stay alive and what the empire really wants.
readIf: you like science fiction about first contact going badly and people trying to stay clever under pressure.
skipIf: you want the humour and crew warmth of the Expanse, since this is colder and more unsettling.

pairings.reason: The authors' earlier series, starting with a mystery that grows into a much larger struggle.
Another story of humanity facing an alien civilisation far more advanced than itself.
A wide-ranging story about alien intelligence, told with more curiosity than menace.
